updates.content:
Title: Some admins may see stale data in the Microsoft 365 Copilot Health page in the Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins may see stale data in the Copilot Health page in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

More info: Specifically, the tenant readiness-score data after September 8, 2026, may be stale.

Current status: We've identified an upstream process responsible for Copilot Health data was disabled, resulting in the impact. We're focusing on restoring this process to ensure new data is generated while developing a strategy to restore the missing data.

Scope of impact: Some admins attempting to see the latest Copilot Health data in the Microsoft 365 admin center may be impacted.

Root cause: An upstream process responsible for Copilot Health data was disabled, resulting in the impact.

Next update by: Wednesday, September 30, 2026, at 12:00 PM UTC
